content: I strive to provide accurate and well-informed answers based on the information I was trained on, which includes a vast range of topics up until my knowledge cutoff in June 2024. However, my confidence can vary depending on the complexity and specificity of the question, as well as the availability of reliable information on the topic. For straightforward factual queries, my confidence is generally high. For more nuanced, subjective, or very recent topics, I may be less certain and will often indicate that or suggest verifying with up-to-date sources. If you ever want me to clarify or elaborate on something, just ask!
